title: The Life of Pythagoras, with Hierocles on the Golden Verses
author: Dacier and Rowe (trans)
description: A historical account of Pythagoras accompanied by Hierocles' commentary on the Golden Verses. The volume brings biography and ethical reflection together, introducing the discipline and ideals associated with the Pythagorean life.
editionNote: Curator-supplied PDF and EPUB from the organised ebook collection. One format was converted from the other (EPUB from PDF). Source text obtained from the Internet Archive (https://archive.org/details/lifepythagorasw00hiergoog).
rights: From the curator's private collection. Publication rights for this edition are to be confirmed before public release.
